entry.author: orchestrator
entry.summary: Panel of 6 workers (SOLID, CleanCode, BigO, CC, CI, ISP) converged after 4 rounds. Architecture v3: 4-layer model (Component → Pattern → View → Step), capability-based providers (ISP), Pattern extensions (OCP), Trie routing (O(log N)), 9-layer test pyramid.
entry.files-added: builder-guide/contracts/PATTERN_CONTRACT.xml (v2 — definePattern + branded ids + extensions) builder-guide/contracts/VIEW_CONTRACT.xml (defineLayoutView + defineRenderView split) builder-guide/contracts/STEP_CONTRACT.xml (v2 — Route + Guards + ViewBinding + Transitions) builder-guide/contracts/PROVIDER_CONTRACT.xml (v2 — capability tokens :read/:write/:stream) builder-guide/contracts/EXTENSIONS_CONTRACT.xml (OCP plugin pattern) builder-guide/contracts/INVENTORY_API.xml (<Inventory> composition root) builder-guide/contracts/TESTING_CONTRACT.xml (9-layer pyramid + budget gates)
entry.decisions-superseded: DS-077 supersede buildPatternsBy approach; STEP_CONTRACT v1 superseded by v2.
entry.key-insights: - SRP: Step split into Route + Guards + ViewBinding + Transitions - ISP: Providers segregated by capability (:read / :write / :stream) - OCP: Pattern extensions array enables cross-cutting concerns without core changes - LSP: SlotKind contract makes patterns within same slot substitutable - DIP: Selectors are pure; depend on capability interfaces, not implementations - Big-O: Trie routing (O log N), reselect with structural sharing, signals for high-freq - Testing: 9-layer pyramid with @surte/test-utils helpers per layer - Resilience: Error boundary per-pattern + per-view + per-inventory (3-tier isolation)
entry.next-step: Builder-guide is complete and self-contained for Claude Code autonomous build. User decides when to scaffold (Phase -1).
